{{Top|leg}}
'''Theonnrl''' was a commentator on [[Gundark's Gear Datalog]] during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. Theonnrl commented on the entry for the [[Model KL-543]] [[tri-laser engraver]], and the downsides of its power requirements.<ref name="GFT">''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]''</ref>
